name: WhoisFreaks_ReverseWhois
author: WhoisFreaks
description: Find domains whose WHOIS matches an email address, or a keyword, owner or company name. 5 credits per page.

configurationItems.name: max_pages
configurationItems.description: Result pages to fetch per run (each page is billed); 1 to 20

configurationItems.name: reverse_whois_search_type
configurationItems.description: WHOIS field to search for 'other' observables: keyword, owner, company or email ('mail' observables always search the email)

configurationItems.name: reverse_whois_exact
configurationItems.description: Require an exact match instead of a partial one

configurationItems.name: reverse_whois_mode
configurationItems.description: default: 50 full WHOIS records per page; mini: 100 compact records per page (domain, dates, name, email, company)
